verdict.rationale: Bank feeds are well documented: Plaid connects to 12,000+ banks and credit cards, with a universal importer as a fallback. Payment and AP/AR systems also sync in, with invoices from Stripe, Mercury and BILL and real-time bill sync from Ramp or BILL. Synced transactions post automatically as double-entry journal entries and are auto-categorized, but payroll is only implied by a 'payroll run' mention, with no named payroll integration. Missing for 10: a documented payroll-provider integration, detail on how Stripe payment activity (not just invoices) reaches the ledger, and independent or hands-on corroboration of automatic sync.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect my banking, payments, and payroll systems so their activity flows into the ledger automatically

citations.quote: Plaid: connects to 12,000+ banks and credit cards. The primary method for most accounts.
View invoices synced from Stripe, Mercury, and BILL, and create and send invoices directly from Kick.
View and manage your bills in Kick, with real-time sync from Ramp or BILL.
Every transaction in Kick - whether it came from your bank, a payroll run, or a bill - generates a journal entry that posts to your general ledger
When transactions sync into Kick, the AI categorizes approximately 97% of them on the first pass
